p: thirsteth: Christ by proposing his graces and gifts to his Church, exempts the hypocrites who are full with their imagined works, and the Epicureans who are full with their worldly lusts, and so do not thirst after these waters.
no money: Signifying that God's benefits cannot be bought for money.
wine and milk without money and: By waters, wine, milk and bread, he means all things necessary to the spiritual life, as these are necessary to this corporal life.

and your labour for that which: He reproves their ingratitude, who refuse those things that God offers willingly, and in the mean time spare neither cost nor labour to obtain those which are not profitable.
fatness: You will be fed abundantly.
sure mercies of David: The same covenant which through my mercy I ratified and confirmed to David, that it would be eternal, 2Sa 7:13, Ac 13:34.
him for a witness to the: Meaning Christ, of whom David was a figure.
and nations that knew not thee: That is, the Gentiles, who before you did not receive to be your people.
found: When he offers himself by the preaching of his word.
forsake his way: By this he shows that repentance must be joined with faith, and how we cannot call on God correctly, unless the fruits of our faith appear.
thoughts are not your thoughts: Although you are not soon reconciled one to another and judge me by yourselves, yet I am easy to be reconciled, yea, I offer my mercies to you.

word be that proceedeth from my: If these small things have their effect, as daily experience shows much more will my promise which I have made and confirmed, bring to pass the things which I have spoken for your deliverance.
mountains and the hills shall break: Read Isa 44:23,49:13
for a name: To set forth his glory.
sign that shall not be cut: Of God's deliverance, and that he will never forsake his Church.
